posts.text: Diageo's annual dividend rate dropped 39.8% to 2.0 USD. Quantic saw the change on Oct 17. The company's current safety label is safe.
PAX GLOBAL cut its dividend by 75.8%, moving from 0.33 HKD to 0.08 HKD. This change was seen on Oct 23.
Allwyn AG increased its annual dividend 40.0% to 0.7 EUR, seen on Oct 23. The 5-year average yield is 7.26%.
Texas Instruments goes ex-dividend on Oct 30. The annual rate is 6.08 USD, yielding 1.97% currently.
Graco has raised its dividend for 26 consecutive years. The current yield of 1.78% is 1.48 times its 5-year average yield of 1.2%.
INTERTEK GROUP PLC cut its dividend 34.5% to 1.08 GBP, seen on Oct 28. The 5-year dividend growth rate is 8.6%.
Microsoft increased its annual dividend to 3.92 USD, a 7.7% rise, seen on Oct 16. The company has a 15-year increase streak.
Nike's current yield is 4.37%, which is 3.1 times its 5-year average yield of 1.41%. The company has 23 consecutive years of increases.
